owner_report.failure: Copy-Item: licenses directory already exists at published application root.

cause: Windows publishing already creates the root licenses directory for engine dependency notices. The later directory Copy-Item lacked -Force and raised a collision instead of merging.
fix: Merge canonical source notices using Copy-Item -LiteralPath ... -Recurse -Force only inside the already-validated fresh application build output. Original SDK/runtime/signature/receipt/source and output-reuse guards remain unchanged.
regression: Execute the actual builder Copy-Item command extracted via PowerShell AST in disposable fixture directories, for absent and existing publish-license directories. Check every source notice hash, preservation of all preexisting published files/source files, nested/Unicode/bracketed paths and refusal of an extra licenses/licenses level.
